name: Fann Lisu
source:
[i]"Look at you, actin' all tough when you don't even have a frayglyph!"[/i]

[i]Sly-Hearted Bully[/i]

A member of the Zhuo family who supervises Taozhe alongside Yuzak. Looks down on anyone weaker than him, and curries favor with the strong. 

[From [url=https://products.voltage.co.jp/neonclash/english/characters/]Voltage Inc.[/url]]
